assumptions: The available local Compustat/CRSP vintages stand in for the paper’s 1995 files; the unchanged A3 SAS construction and common Table 2 sample are reused after helper-verified dataset hashes.

The system is estimated by direct native Stata mlexp as a conditional Gaussian likelihood with independent, homoskedastic equation disturbances and separate constant variances. This diagonal covariance assumption is a disclosed best-effort identification choice, not a reported source assumption or an exact recovery of the author’s GLS weights.

The unrestricted forecasting equation is checked against native OLS in accordance with source footnote 9; the unrestricted return equation is checked against its OLS reparameterization on the same N=55,064 observations.

All five source likelihood-ratio restrictions are directly re-estimated on the common sample with 1, 1, 1, 2, and 3 degrees of freedom. Inference uses conditional-Gaussian likelihood ratios, not an invented unweighted 2N log-SSR ratio; the source does not specify its GLS weighting or system SSR normalization.
Table 2 source N is 51,579; the unchanged local A3 construction yields 55,064 complete system rows. The population/vintage difference is reported, not tuned away.

limitations: Historical population and coverage of current local Compustat/CRSP files are unverified; the final 59,585-row baseline and 55,064-row complete system sample exceed the paper’s 56,692 and 51,579. Link/name ambiguity counts are zero, final firm-year duplicates are zero, and the remaining population difference has no single demonstrated cause.
The exact historical CRSP size-breakpoint series and the paper’s 1995 file vintage are unavailable; local December market-cap ranks approximate CRSP capitalization deciles.

The paper specifies a minimum of six observations at SIC-year level and exchange-split Jones fits, leaving the intended exchange-cell minimum ambiguous. The literal SIC-year screen is used without adding an exchange minimum. A native model-rank guard retains only Jones fits with all three regressors estimable, including full-rank three-row exact fits with zero residual degrees of freedom; groups and rows rejected for rank deficiency or missing model degrees of freedom are reported in review.md.
The exact order and reference population of the three-standard-deviation screen are not reported; it is applied within exchange-specific Jones cells before the combined SIC-year minimum-six screen.

Stata’s table p-values for coefficients are two-sided tests against zero; the five Panel B p-values are chi-square tests of equality restrictions with 1, 1, 1, 2, and 3 degrees of freedom. The paper interprets coefficient differences directionally after reporting two-sided equality tests.

The source reports 2N ln(SSRc/SSRu) but does not specify how the system SSR is normalized or weighted. The delivered restrictions use native Gaussian system likelihood-ratio tests from nlsur ifgnls; they are the defensible joint-system best effort, not an exact reproduction of the printed SSR ratio.

Non-USD amounts lacking positive unique exact-DATADATE GBP-to-reporting and GBP-to-USD rate legs remain unavailable; this includes their dependent differences, scaled variables, and lead earnings. CURRTR is not used because its local label does not establish arithmetic direction. The final sample's remaining missing currency codes, unavailable rate flags, and resulting sample changes are reported in review.md.
